In addition, the ACDI collaborates closely with other projects in the ACLU’s national office, as well as ACLU affiliates and national partners, to drive advocacy that affirmatively fight the harms of laws and policies that restrict access to care.

Qualifying applicants must currently be matriculated legal students and must be based in the U.S. for the entire duration of the internship.

The Team:

The Capital Punishment Project, part of the ACLU’s Center for Justice, challenges the unfairness and arbitrariness of capital punishment while working toward the ultimate goal of abolishing the death penalty. The Project engages in public advocacy and strategic litigation, including the direct representation of capital defendants, challenges to systemic problems in the administration of capital punishment, and amicus briefing.

What You’ll Do:

The intern will have the opportunity to gain valuable experience by working alongside the team and assisting in factual investigation, and legal research and writing, among other tasks to advance our litigation and integrated advocacy.

Qualifying applicants must currently be matriculated legal students and must be based in the U.S. for the entire duration of the internship.

The Team:

The Criminal Law Reform Project advocates for the constitutional and civil rights of those impacted by criminal legal systems. We use litigation and advocacy to confront systemic government conduct that fuels the carceral state and police abuse, and oppresses people based on race, class, and other characteristics. Ultimately, we seek to shift power to under-resourced communities and to elevate approaches to justice and safety that advance fundamental rights for all.

About the Role

The ACLU seeks a Spring Legal Intern in the LGBTQ & HIV Project of the ACLU’s National office. This position may be remote or hybrid based in New York, NY. This internship is for course credit only.

Qualifying applicants must currently be matriculated legal students and must be based in the U.S. for the entire duration of the internship.

The Team:

The LGBTQ & HIV Project seeks to create a just society for all LGBTQ people and people living with HIV regardless of race or income. Through litigation, lobbying, public education, and organizing, the ACLU works to build a country where our communities can live openly without discrimination and enjoy equal rights, personal autonomy, and freedom of expression and association.  

The LGBTQ & HIV Project was founded in 1986, but the ACLU has advocated for the rights of lesbian, gay, and bisexual people at least since 1936, and for the rights of transgender people at least since 1967.

Qualifying applicants must currently be matriculated legal students and must be based in the U.S. for the entire duration of the internship.

The Team:

The Disability Rights Program’s mission is to achieve an America free of discrimination against people with disabilities; where people with disabilities are valued, integrated members of society who have full access to education, homes, health care, jobs, families, voting and civic engagement. We fight to ensure that people with disabilities are no longer segregated into, and over-represented in, civil and criminal institutions such as nursing homes, psychiatric hospitals, jails, and prisons.

The ACLU has fought for decades for the rights of people with disabilities - achieving key wins to stop coerced mental health treatment and unnecessary institutionalization, as well as playing a role in the drafting of the ADA. Company Overview   

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.

And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.

We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.

Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy,

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb’s mission is to create a world where people can Belong Anywhere. As we work to achieve that mission, our cross functional Tech Operations and Programs team helps enable Tech organizations to execute and deliver on high impact programs and initiatives. 

The Difference You Will Make:

You will decide what the engineering world knows about Airbnb.

  • Our engineers solve hard problems at scale across infrastructure, data, and applied AI — and they write about that work well. Almost none of the engineers we'd most like to hire have ever seen it.
  • You'll change that, and the change is measurable. A year in, senior candidates should arrive already able to describe our technical work accurately, because they found it before we found them. Our engineers should be recognised names in their fields rather than anonymous authors. Airbnb should be the source people cite on at least one technical domain.

Cartesian is building spatial intelligence for indoor environments to drive operational efficiency. Anthropic’s Inference organization serves Claude to millions of users and enterprise customers, across our own products and the world’s largest cloud platforms, with the speed, reliability, and efficiency that frontier AI demands. The stack that makes this possible is deep and tightly coupled: accelerator kernels, an in-house inference engine that manages the entire token path for both production and research workloads, distributed routing, autoscaling, and capacity management. Every layer affects the others, often in ways that are hard to see in isolation. We build across GPUs, TPUs, and Trainium, and the complexity of building, testing, and shipping inference software grows with every platform we add.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the programs that scale it. The work spans four closely coupled areas:

  • Scaling and infrastructure. Routing, autoscaling, and capacity management for the serving fleet, and bringing new capacity online.

jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

The ParkX Porter is responsible for maintaining cleanliness in the common areas at assigned sites. Duties include general upkeep such as pressure washing, window cleaning, trash removal, and routine cleaning tasks. Key Responsibilities

  • Reports to assigned location in the approved ParkX Porter uniform.
  • Reports to assigned location before the start of the work shift.
  • Ensures compliance with all safety regulations and cleaning standards.
  • Exhibits a professional and courteous demeanor with all site visitors.
  • Acknowledges, greets, and interacts professionally with property staff and guests, using appropriate protocols.
  • Assists management teams with special cleaning or maintenance requests as needed.
  • Always maintains a neat and orderly janitorial closet and storage areas, free of debris and hazards.

Descripción General del Puesto:

El Supervisor de Limpieza de ParkX es responsable de mantener la limpieza en las áreas comunes de los sitios asignados.   • Realiza lavado a presión en las áreas asignadas por la gerencia.

Job Overview

The Residential Sr. Property Manager will lead the onsite team and oversee all activities to achieve budgeted leasing, occupancy, and financial goals at a community in the heart of Charlotte, NC. This metro-accessible property is part of Comstock’s growing portfolio, offering the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both your team and the company as a whole. The Property Manager will also be responsible for training and developing staff while ensuring best-in-class customer service and alignment with Comstock’s brand standards and culture.

  • Partner closely with Comstock’s Marketing team to develop and execute marketing strategies, campaigns, and events tailored to luxury community, ensuring adherence to brand standards.
  • Oversee daily leasing activity, pricing strategies, concession management, and market analysis.

jobs.title: Service Manager (Condo)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

The Service Manager (Condo) is responsible for the seamless operation, maintenance, and presentation of all building systems within a luxury high-residences. This role is critical to delivering a five-star living experience by ensuring reliability, discretion, and excellence in all engineering services. #weshowup

The Service Manager (Condo) leads the engineering team, oversees complex building systems, manages high-value capital projects, and works closely with property management and the Board of Directors to protect and enhance the asset’s value. This individual is expected to operate at a high level of professionalism, technical expertise, and resident service.

Key Responsibilities

Luxury Building Operations & Resident Experience

  • Ensure all building systems operate at peak efficiency with zero disruption to residents whenever possible.
  • Deliver a “white-glove” level of service—responding promptly, professionally, and discreetly to resident concerns.
  • Maintain immaculate condition and presentation of all mechanical rooms, back-of-house areas, and service corridors.
  • Coordinate work to minimize noise, inconvenience, and visual impact in occupied residences.

Engineering Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing engineering team with a service-first mindset.

jobs.title: Retention Specialist (Remote)
jobs.description_text:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. There’s something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams.  Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We’re energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we’re just getting started!

As a Retention Specialist at Constant Contact, your role is to become a trusted advisor and advocate for our customers at a critical decision point. You will engage directly with customers expressing an intent to cancel or downgrade, and through your consultative, empathetic, and solutions-driven approach, you’ll help them rediscover the value of our platform. This position is pivotal in preserving revenue, reducing churn, and ensuring our customers feel heard, supported, and successful.

This is not an entry-level position. You must demonstrate seasoned judgment, advanced negotiation techniques, and a deep understanding of how our platform supports small businesses and nonprofits.

What You’ll Do

  • Customer Retention Excellence
     Respond promptly and professionally
